verdict.rationale: Bases is a first-party core plugin for creating database-like views of notes, and community users describe it as a faster, near-complete replacement for the Dataview plugin that turns queries into tables. Notion databases also import as Bases, which supports the structured-data model. Missing for 10: documentation of filtering and querying by frontmatter properties, evidence of board and list view types beyond tables, and in-depth first-party docs (community notes say Bases is not yet as comprehensive as Dataview).
